episodes.175682: A secondary cold front swept eastward through northern Ohio during the late afternoon through late evening of January 19th as its parent low drifted eastward from central Lake Michigan toward Saginaw Bay. This secondary cold front was accompanied by a line of multicellular showers and thunderstorms as the front encountered a high shear/low CAPE environment, including weak surface-based CAPE. The showers and thunderstorms produced sporadic straight-line convective wind damage in northern Ohio as precipitation was very efficient at transporting 50 knot flow at and near 850 mb down to the surface.
episodes.175796: A dynamically strong upper level system impacted east central Indiana during the afternoon hours of January 19th.  Instability was weak, but cold temepratures aloft allowed for widespread small hail and isolated areas of hail up to the size of nickels.  The only impactful damage occurred in Decatur county with more widespread severe weather as the system continued to develop into Ohio.
episodes.176225: A secondary cold front swept eastward over western Lake Erie during the late afternoon through early evening of the 19th as its parent low drifted eastward from central Lake Michigan toward Saginaw Bay. This secondary cold front was accompanied by a line of multicellular showers and thunderstorms as the front encountered a high shear/low CAPE environment, including weak surface-based CAPE. The showers and thunderstorms produced a gale-force peak convective gust at the Toledo Crib C-MAN station. Precip was very efficient at transporting a large proportion of 50 knot flow at and near 850 mb down to the lake surface.
episodes.177237: A cold front associated with an occluding surface low pressure over Illinois pushed through the local waters in the early morning hours of January 19th. Along the front, thunderstorms developed into a line and began producing winds gusts in excess of 34 knots across Lake Pontchartrain and Lake Borgne. The line of storms weakened shortly afterwards and the cold front pushed out of the waters by mid-morning.
episodes.180920: A couple of severe thunderstorms occurred.
